features.name: Bent-wood side panel sweeping from the base up to the arm
features.note: Flat-topped slab with a round nose at seat height; gap to the arm all along; the photo's panel tapers, deep at the back, rising to the arm

features.name: Flat paddle arm with a rounded front, on a front post
Thin wooden front rail that wraps the front corners
Tapered legs splayed outward, set under the side panels
Three thick seat cushions with flat fronts
Three back cushions, 3 x 2 biscuit tufting (top row taller)
features.note: Grid right, but 18 separate puffy blocks; the photo has one soft cushion each with shallow seams

features.name: Back cushions lean back; no frame shows above them
Side panel rises behind the arm toward the back cushions
features.note: Top stays flat at seat level; a rear post stands in for the rise

differences: Top edge climbs from seat height at the front post to the arm underside at the back; drop the rear post
Tapered shell, deep at the back, narrowing to the front, large bottom-front curve into the rail
Continuous back cushions with shallow 3 x 2 seams, rows similar height, soft rounded top
Arm runs further back and curves in; front overhangs further past the post
Panel wraps the seat cushion sides, top at or above the cushion top toward the back
